citation.title: Pulse oximetry values from 33,080 participants in the Apple Heart & Movement Study
citation.authors: Bent B, Cho PJ, April M, Kellogg RA, Allen NB, Williams JA, Yarostski J, Dunn JP

overnight_reduction.description: mean SpO2 approximately 0.8% lower during overnight hours vs daytime

typical_range.note: Published aggregate patterns, not individual time-series

demographic_stratification.description: Similar circadian patterns observed across all demographic groups

validation_envelope.scope: healthy adult SpO2 circadian patterns and population ranges
validation_envelope.applicable_to: face validity checks for resting SpO2 levels
validation_envelope.usable_for: qualitative circadian pattern validation, resting baseline range checks

notes: Large-scale observational data (72M measurements) provides robust population ranges
Individual time-series not available - aggregate patterns only
Suitable for face validity: resting SpO2 should remain 95-100% in healthy baseline
Cannot be used for parameter calibration or individual trace validation
